title: Reading and writing CSV with pandas
summary: pd.read_csv and its most useful options (dates, separators, dtypes, missing markers, comments), and to_csv.
hints: `load_sales`: `pd.read_csv(path, parse_dates=["date"])`. `load_european`: `pd.read_csv(path, sep=";", decimal=",")` so `"2,50"` becomes the float 2.5.
`load_customers`: `pd.read_csv(path, usecols=["id", "name", "zip"], dtype={"zip": str}, index_col="id")`. Without `dtype`, pandas guesses `zip` is a number and `02139` loses its leading zero.

`load_scores`: `na_values=["n/a", "-", "missing"]` adds to the markers pandas already treats as missing (empty fields, `NA`, `NaN`...), so the column can be numeric. `load_export`: `comment="#"` skips lines that start with `#`. `save_csv`: `df.to_csv(path, index=False)`.
